name: The equinox gale
story: The big one, and the only day of the year the club stays shut. A full southeast gale from before dawn, rain hammering the hangar roof, the sea white and the cloud on the deck; the front through at midday with a screaming squall, and a long, wild, showery clearing. By midnight, stars.
forecast: GALE WARNING, NO VFR FROM DAWN TO 18:00. Southeast 18 kt gusting 28 from dawn, heavy rain, cloud base 200 m. The cold front 12:00-13:30: gusts to 45 kt, visibility 2-3 km. Veering west, showers to dusk. Clearing overnight.
